events.title: Mozambique sets December deadline to surrender illegal weapons
events.description: Der Präsident von Mosambik kündigte an, dass bis Dezember alle illegalen Schusswaffen abgegeben werden müssen, um die Sicherheit zu erhöhen.

events.title: One killed after Riyadh airport hit again, a day after deadly strike killed 12
events.description: Ein weiterer Raketenangriff traf das King‑Khalid‑International‑Airport in Riad und forderte ein Todesopfer sowie zahlreiche Verletzte.

events.title: Taiwan says it is closely monitoring a series of Chinese live‑fire drills
events.description: Taiwan beobachtet intensiv die von China im östlichen Meer durchgeführten Schießübungen, die nahe an die taiwanesische Küste heranreichen.

events.title: (URGENT) N. Korea's ballistic missiles flew over 900 km: JCS
events.description: North Korea launched a ballistic missile that traveled more than 900 km, flying over the sea toward South Korea.

events.title: Houthis kill 14 at Saudi airport as expert warns of 'rapid targets' amid Middle East war
events.description: Iran‑backed Houthi rebels struck King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, killing at least 14 people and injuring over 300.

events.title: Slovenia rejects bill in blow to PM Janez Jansa’s reform agenda
events.description: A referendum rejected a bill expanding parliamentary inquiry powers, dealing a setback to Prime Minister Janez Janša’s reforms.

events.title: Houthis, Saudis ratchet up violence with back-and-forth airport strikes
events.description: Iran‑backed Houthi rebels and Saudi Arabia exchanged attacks on each other's airports, escalating regional tension.

events.title: Iran calls U.S. response "insufficient" amid stalled talks to end the war
events.description: Iran criticised the United States for what it described as an inadequate effort to negotiate an end to the conflict in Yemen.

events.title: Djibouti boat wreck leaves 139 migrants dead, 84 missing: UN
events.description: A migrant vessel capsized while sailing from Djibouti to Yemen, resulting in at least 139 deaths and dozens missing.

events.title: Authorities successfully rescue Nile cruise ship carrying 99 tourists
events.description: Egyptian authorities refloated the cruise ship “Courchette” after it ran aground near the Kom Ombo Temple on the Nile.

events.title: A migrant boat sank off the coast of Djibouti with the UN reporting over 200 people dead or missing
events.description: Un'imbarcazione carica di migranti è affondata al largo di Djibouti, causando almeno 109 morti e più di 116 dispersi.

events.title: Allerta in Polonia: "C'è un piano per uccidere il premier Tusk"
events.description: Il ministero dell'Interno ha convocato un incontro d'urgenza per fronteggiare un presunto complotto contro il premier Donald Tusk.

events.title: Sudan: Diplomatic Setbacks Undermine U.S. Approach to Sudan
events.description: Negli ultimi due settimane Washington ha subito una serie di sconfitte diplomatiche nel tentativo di spingere il Sudan verso un accordo di cessate il fuoco.

events.title: Sudan: Diplomatic Setbacks Undermine U.S. Approach to Sudan
events.description: Recent diplomatic defeats have hampered Washington’s effort to push Sudanese authorities toward a cease‑fire agreement.

events.title: Passenger Terminal At Riyadh Airport Is Struck Again, A Day After 12 Were Killed
events.description: A second attack hit King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, causing injuries after a projectile struck terminals 3 and 4.

events.title: Abbas delays Palestinian elections again, making more than two decades without vote
events.description: Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas postponed the long‑awaited elections to 2027, extending a near‑20‑year hiatus.

events.title: Leading Chinese mathematicians unite behind use of AI in research
events.description: Matematici cinesi hanno formato un'alleanza a Pechino per integrare l'intelligenza artificiale nella ricerca matematica.

events.title: Yemen's Houthis renew warning over Saudi airports after deadly Riyadh attack
events.description: Gli Houthi hanno nuovamente avvertito le compagnie aeree e i viaggiatori di evitare gli aeroporti sauditi dopo l'attacco più mortale in un decennio.

events.title: Afghanistan opens potential China trade route to Persian Gulf
events.description: Afghanistan announced a new overland trade corridor linking China to the Persian Gulf, aiming to boost its economy.

events.title: Ambasciata Usa alza il livello di allerta per i connazionali in Arabia Saudita
events.description: The U.S. Embassy raised its alert level for American citizens in Saudi Arabia, limiting staff access to Jeddah and Dammam airports.

events.title: Middle East war, high debt levels to dominate IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok
events.description: Finance officials gathered in Bangkok to discuss the global impact of the Middle East war and rising sovereign debt.

events.title: Ghana seeks BRICS membership to broaden trade and diplomatic options
events.description: Accra announced Ghana's application to join the BRICS bloc, aiming to diversify its economic partnerships beyond traditional Western allies.

events.title: Red Cross chief says she tried to arrange Gaza hostage visits through talks with Hamas's Haniyeh
events.description: The Red Cross negotiated with Hamas to enable visits for families of Gaza hostages, facilitating humanitarian contact.

events.title: Pakistan has ‘robust’ nuclear security regime: IAEA
events.description: The IAEA praised Pakistan’s nuclear security framework, noting its far‑reaching impact on global safety.

events.title: India-U.S. trade pact to be finalised keeping changed circumstances in mind: Piyush Goyal
events.description: India and the United States agreed to finalize a bilateral trade pact, expanding economic cooperation between the two countries.

events.title: Zaporizhzhia sotto attacco: un raid russo uccide 15 persone, tra loro anche tre bambini
events.description: Un raid aereo russo su Zaporizhzhia ha colpito edifici residenziali, provocando 15 morti, inclusi tre bambini.

events.title: What to Know About the Delhi Protests
events.description: Le proteste a New Delhi contro le revisioni dei registri elettorali hanno incontrato una risposta di polizia in forza.

events.title: Ethiopia tells UN it is acting in self‑defence against Eritrea
events.description: Ethiopia informed the UN Security Council that it is taking self‑defence measures in response to alleged Eritrean aggression.

events.title: Government proposes €141bn cut to EU budget
events.description: Il governo irlandese ha proposto un taglio di 141 miliardi di euro al bilancio pluriennale dell'UE.

events.title: US Ships US$75 Million of Fuel to Cuba in August
events.description: U.S. fuel exports to Cuba reached almost $75 million in August, marking a significant increase in trade between the two countries.

events.title: South Korean ambassador leaves Ukraine
events.description: Seoul announced the recall of its ambassador from Kyiv amid escalating tensions in the region.

events.title: Taiwan’s leader says increasing defense spending to ‘deter war’
events.description: Taiwan ha earmarked a record NT$1.1 trillion for defense in 2027, over 3 % of GDP, to strengthen deterrence against mainland China.

events.title: FlyDubai Co-Pilot Intended To Crash Plane Into Tel Aviv Airport, UAE Prosecutor Says
events.description: UAE prosecutors say a FlyDubai co‑pilot tried to hijack a flight and crash it into Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv.

events.title: US urges South Korea to uphold alliance standards
events.description: A senior US official warned Seoul to maintain alliance commitments amid concerns over intelligence cooperation.

events.title: Trump, Putin agree on deal to release Russian diesel to US, world markets
events.description: President Trump announces a pact with President Putin for Russia to supply diesel to global markets, easing fuel prices.

events.title: Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize as US sanctions threaten international justice
events.description: South African-born jurist Navi Pillay receives the Nobel Peace Prize for her work defending international law.

events.title: Massive 7.7 magnitude earthquake strikes Panama as officials investigate potential tsunami threat
events.description: A powerful 7.7‑magnitude quake hits Panama’s southern coast, prompting tsunami warnings across the region.

events.title: Estados Unidos sanciona a la Corte Penal Internacional horas después del Nobel de la Paz a una exjueza
events.description: EEUU impone sanciones a la Corte Penal Internacional tras la entrega del Nobel de la Paz a Navi Pillay.

events.title: The ICC strongly rejects US sanctions against the institution
events.description: The International Criminal Court publicly denounces recent US sanctions targeting the court.

events.title: Imposing Sanctions on the International Criminal Court - U.S. Department of State
events.description: Il Dipartimento di Stato degli Stati Uniti ha annunciato sanzioni contro la Corte Penale Internazionale.

events.title: Sottosegretario Dell'Utri alla Arctic Circle Assembly di Reykjavik — Ribadito l'impegno dell'Italia nella regione artica
events.description: Il sottosegretario italiano ha partecipato all'Assemblea dell'Artico a Reykjavik, ribadendo l'impegno dell'Italia nella cooperazione artica.

events.title: EU cracks down on airlines adding 'rip‑off' charges for cabin bags
events.description: L'Unione Europea ha introdotto nuove regole per vietare le tariffe aggiuntive per i bagagli a mano, con effetto a partire da una data stabilita.

events.title: Poland seeks to put Central Bank Governor on trial; zloty drops
events.description: Il parlamento polacco ha avanzato una proposta per mettere il governatore della Banca Centrale a processo, provocando un forte calo dello zloty.

events.title: South Africa: Home Affairs Withdraws Asylum Directive After Violent Anti-Immigration Protests
events.description: The Department of Home Affairs withdrew a directive on asylum intake following violent protests in Durban and Soweto.

events.title: Spy agency snub raises U.S. alliance concerns in S. Korea
events.description: A recent snub of Seoul's spy agency during a trilateral meeting has sparked worries in Washington about the strength of the U.S.–South Korea alliance.

events.title: 2 foreign nationals breach UK base housing key US, NATO intel hub amid $556M expansion
events.description: Two Latvian men were arrested after breaching the perimeter of RAF Molesworth, a critical US‑NATO intelligence facility in the UK.

events.title: Japan's tourist spending windfall shrinks as Chinese visitors plunge
events.description: A sharp drop in Chinese arrivals cut Japan’s tourism revenue, raising concerns for the country’s post‑pandemic recovery.

events.title: US imposes fresh sanctions on Iran's shadow fleet
events.description: Gli Stati Uniti hanno annunciato nuove sanzioni contro la flotta ombra iraniana, mirate a limitare le sue attività marittime.
